title: Abarenganye Isezerano Bajanwe mu Buhungiro
intro: Mu misi ya mbere y’umuryango mushasha, umuryango umwe wahora uba mu mazu akomeye, aboheshejwe n’isezerano. Igihe iryo sezerano ryahemuka, ingaruka zaryo zasubiyemwo biciye ku mapaji ya Korowani. Abo bantu bari bande, kandi amazu yabo n’imirima yabo y’ivyamwa vyabaye iki?
clues: Twaba mu bibanza bikomeye vyatuma twumva ko dutekanye mu buryo butari bwo.
Twari abantu b’Ivyanditswe, yamara twaciye isezerano ryacu.
Twarateguye umugambi wo kurwanya iyo ntumwa imaze kuza iwacu, ariko uwo mugambi wacu warananiwe.
Ibiti vyacu vy’imisukoni vyaciwe n’itegeko rya Allah, ikimenyetso c’ububasha bwiwe.
Twararukanwe mu mihana yacu, ntituzokwigera dusubirayo, nk’igihano c’ukuntu twateye akagere.
Korowani iratuvuga mu kigabane c’ikoraniro, kandi inkuru yacu iratanga imburi ku barenga ku masezerano.

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
